starting.title: Starting GhostCam…
starting.sub: A few seconds to make this PC reachable from the Internet.

pair.title: Scan with your phone
pair.sub: With the camera app, on 4G/5G or Wi-Fi.
pair.sub2: Nothing is stored on the phone.

ready.title: Phone connected
ready.sub: {{mode}} · press the red button on the phone to record.

live.label: Recording on this PC
live.netWarn: The phone's network can't keep up with the chosen quality: lower it in the settings (next video).

foot.upnp: Port open on the router (UPnP) · direct connection possible

settings.title: Settings
settings.appliesNext: Applies from the next video, without reconnecting the phone.

eco.label: Economy
eco.risk: Safest on a weak network: the least delay.

standard.label: Standard
standard.risk: Good balance between sharpness and reliability. Recommended.

high.label: High
high.risk: Needs a good upload connection. Otherwise: choppy video or delay.

max.label: Maximum
max.risk: For Wi-Fi or very good 4G/5G. High risk of delay on mobile networks.

quality.warnNeed: The phone must be able to upload ≈ {{rate}} continuously.
quality.warnIf: If its connection can't keep up:
quality.warnDirect: Direct connection: the video stays real-time, but gets choppy (fewer frames per second) and compression becomes more visible.
quality.warnRelay: Encrypted relay: the video piles up on the phone before being sent. Those seconds are not on the PC yet and would be lost if the phone were destroyed. The phone shows how many seconds are waiting.

buffer.helpOff: Real time: nothing waits on the phone, but on a weak network the video can freeze.
buffer.helpOn: Network drops no longer freeze the video: it reaches the PC a little later. The phone keeps the delay under {{n}} s by lowering the quality; if the network is too slow even in Economy, the delay keeps growing (shown on the phone and the PC). Waiting seconds stay in the phone's memory (never in its storage) and would be lost if the phone were destroyed.

update.confirmPhone: GhostCam will restart and the phone will have to scan the new QR code. Update now?

tunnel.helpCloudflare: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel: no account needed. The connector is downloaded and kept up to date automatically.
tunnel.helpLocalhostrun: SSH tunnel built into GhostCam: nothing to download, no account. The free address changes more often, so the phone may have to scan again.
tunnel.helpCustom: Any HTTPS address you control that forwards to this computer at {{target}}: ngrok, Tailscale Funnel, a Cloudflare named tunnel, your own reverse proxy…
tunnel.restart: Changing the link gives a new QR code: the phone will have to scan it.

intro.text: The video is sent live to your PC and never stored on this phone.
intro.invalidLink: Invalid pairing link: scan the QR code shown on the PC.

info.recording: Recording on the PC, nothing is kept here

conn.noDirect: No direct path, trying the relay…
conn.refused: Connection refused: this is not your PC

toast.lost: Connection lost: what was filmed is already on the PC
toast.qualityDown: Network too slow: quality lowered to {{quality}} (new file)
toast.flushFailed: Connection lost: the last seconds did not reach the PC
toast.flushing_one: Video stopped · the last second is still being sent to the PC
toast.flushing_other: Video stopped · the last {{count}} seconds are still being sent to the PC

error.dirNotAbsolute: The folder must be a full path (e.g. D:\Videos\GhostCam)
error.tunnelURL: The custom address must be a full https:// URL (e.g. https://ghostcam.example.org)
